summary: The right words can make an invitation, apology, negotiation, or difficult conversation much easier to receive.
body: The right words can make an invitation, apology, negotiation, or difficult conversation much easier to receive. When Mercury conjoins Venus, communication and connection fuse, giving language more charm and making agreement, affection, creativity, and social ease easier to express. Say the kind thing you have been meaning to say, make the offer, or put some beauty into work that has become too functional. Soften the delivery, but refuse to dilute your actual requirement just to keep the peace. You can preserve the relationship and still ensure your boundary is impossible to miss.
